# Kaico Voice
> Kaico builds and runs the online front door for the trades: the website, the Google listing, and the phone that answers when you can't.

- [Client Services Agreement | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/client-agreement): The standard terms for every Kaico Voice engagement: payment, month to month with 30 days notice, ownership of your site and data, and how the phone is handled.
- [Website, Google Listing and Phone for Trades | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/): Kaico builds and runs the online front door for HVAC, plumbing, electrical and roofing shops: website, Google listing and a phone that answers. Free audit.
- [HVAC Answering Service | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/industries/hvac): HVAC answering service that picks up on the first ring, books straight to your calendar and works after hours. Built for heating and air companies.
- [Roofing Answering Service | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/industries/roofing): Roofing answering service that picks up when the hail does: storm calls answered 24/7, booked to your calendar, texted to your phone. Hear it live.
- [Pricing | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/pricing): Front Door Audit free. Website builds from $3,500, Front Door Fix $1,500, Front Door $900 a month, Growth $1,750. Month to month, 30 days notice.
- [Privacy Policy | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/privacy): How Kaico Voice handles your information when you call a business using our AI receptionist.
- [Proof | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/proof): What Kaico has built, stated honestly: Blue Sands, 24 pages, a pricing calculator and a self-serve scheduler, and how every number we quote is verified.
- [After-Hours Answering Service for the Trades | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/services/phone): An after-hours answering service for the trades: every call picked up, booked to your calendar, summarized to your phone. Hear it live: (918) 359-2644.
- [Contractor Website Design | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/services/websites): Contractor website design that books the job: click-to-call, a real quote form, your Google listing wired in. From $3,500. Start with a free audit.
- [SMS Program Details | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/sms): How the Kaico Voice SMS program works: what messages you receive, how to opt in, how to opt out, and your privacy.
- [Terms of Service | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/terms): Terms governing your use of Kaico Voice services and SMS notifications.
